gloss: to acquire, to learn, to wear

definitions.gloss: to acquire, to learn, to master
definitions.explanation: To gain knowledge or skills through learning and practice; to make something one's own.
To wear or put on clothing, accessories, or equipment.

notes:
COMPOUND: ⟦{身|み}→身：01764_mi⟧ (body) + ⟦につける→つける：00562_tsukeru⟧ (to attach to)

SENSE 1 (acquire/learn):
- ⟦{知識|ちしき}→知識：01463_chishiki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{身|み}につける (acquire knowledge)
- ⟦{技術|ぎじゅつ}→技術：01389_gijutsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{身|み}につける (master a skill)
- ⟦{習慣|しゅうかん}→習慣：01429_shuukan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{身|み}につける (develop a habit)
- ⟦{力|ちから}→力：01661_chikara⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{身|み}につける (gain strength/ability)

SENSE 2 (wear):
- ⟦{服|ふく}→服：00695_fuku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{身|み}につける (wear clothes)
- ⟦{時計|とけい}→時計：00677_tokei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{身|み}につける (wear a watch)
- ⟦{香水|こうすい}→香水：00247_kousui⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{身|み}につける (wear perfume)

NUANCE: For sense 1, {身|み}につける implies that something becomes part of you through practice, not just superficial learning.
